need to know maximum current draw of system.

![circuit diagram](/_sources/power/diode-diode24.gif)

zener max power rating: $P_z$
zener breakdown voltage: $V_z$
zener max current: $I_z = P_z/V_z$

source voltage: $V_s$
- open circuit voltage of solar panel

minimum series resistor
$R_s = (V_s-V_z)/I_z)$
